test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If in a certain code language SPECTROSCOPY is written as ESPRCTCOSYOP, how will EXTRAVAGANZA be written in that code language?
solution:
Here, the following logic is used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a67854f975d12c763e2a95eaa6061c4a222bdaf61bbfa66183b99fa200e07c83.png] 

**'SPECTROSCOPY' = 'ESPRCTCOSYOP'**

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78b8c98bb176643f9ee7fee38486f4760482e1dfadb9479e6ee7be8aeba410ba.png] 

**'EXTRAVAGANZA' = 'TEXVRAAAGANZ'**

Hence, the correct answer is **option (2).**
